h1: Custom Frosted Photo Frames for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Frosted Photo Frames | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom frosted photo frames in bulk for your next event. Perfect for employee gifts and client appreciation.
introHtml: Frosted photo frames offer a subtle, elegant finish that diffuses light and adds a soft, modern touch to your photos. Unlike clear frames, the frosted surface minimizes fingerprints and glare, making them ideal for desk displays in corporate offices or trade show giveaways. Decorate with your logo or message using screen printing or etching for a polished, professional look that recipients will appreciate.
heroAltText: Custom frosted photo frames with engraved logo on an office desk, holding a team photo
